Meet the Baseus Portable Wireless Air Compressor—the ultimate pocket-sized roadside lifesaver. Forget about bulky, tangled cords or searching for a gas station in the middle of nowhere.   • Advanced Heat Dissipation: Built-in cooling fans and intelligent safety circuits protect the device against overheating, overcharging, and short circuits.

Fills a Flat Tire in 5 Minutes

The 19mm Turbo Fill alloy pump delivers fast airflow to fully inflate a flat tire in 5 minutes—far outperforming ordinary inflators.

Built-in high-precision sensor provides 0.05 BAR accuracy for reliable, worry-free inflation.

Preset the inflation range value to avoid over-inflation or improper inflation, safe and reliable.

Start inflation with just 1 push of a button, and supports customization.

Contains 2 sets of 18650 high-discharge lithium battery for a much longer standby time.

High-accuracy barometric sensor monitors the tire pressure in real-time to avoid danger.

3 professional air nozzles are included, no need to purchase.
